# Video edit recipes: J-cuts, whip pans, click zooms and CTA end cards

**An edit request like 'zoom into the button' becomes a named take with timing, the common mistake and a recipe per engine.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_5330f5f9ebc7.webp" alt="Named edits applied with ffmpeg: a dancer twirling on a theatre stage whips into a vintage microphone in orange light beams, then a zoom transition into a glowing crystal reliquary." width="480"></p>

A library of named edits an agent adds to footage, each with what it looks like, when to use it, the common mistake and how to build it in FFmpeg, HyperFrames, Remotion and CapCut. Cuts and pacing (J-cut, L-cut, match cut, speed ramp), transitions (whip pan, zoom, glitch, light leak, masks, FFmpeg xfade, Remotion and shader transitions), words on screen (headlines, callouts, lower thirds, reviews, end cards and CTAs), showing a product (UI walkthroughs, cursor clicks, device mockups, code and terminal screens, agent flows) and visuals (counters and charts, logo walls, grids and carousels, backdrops). Use when someone asks for a transition, a cut, a title, a lower third, a testimonial, an end card, a CTA, a screen-recording zoom, a cursor, a phone or laptop mockup, a code or terminal animation, an animated number or chart, a logo wall or a background while editing a video. Not for choosing an editing service (use varg-video-editing) or generating new footage (varg-ai).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-video-edit-library                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-video-edit-library --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Add a whip-pan transition between the two scenes in edit.mp4, FFmpeg only"
- "Zoom in on every click in screen.mp4 and add an oversized cursor, in my HyperFrames project"
- "Give my Remotion video an end card with a CTA button and the URL typed into an address bar"
